自古以来，修仙是正统，成仙能知天地、得永生、创造新的一界；成魔则人人喊打，因为一旦堕落成魔，往往会掌握规则、避生死、毁天灭地。并且自古至今传说中只有一人入魔成功，其他的都被自己的逆转灵力焚成灰土。

再嗑几枚药，身上射出腾腾冰雾，他要用冰系法术抵抗这火牢！冰雾与火焰相触，制造出巨大的能量波动！巨大的能量旋风刮起，一时间火牢内压的速度减缓了不少。

‘‘没事李老师，只是大挂历掉了，你不用管了，我自己弄就好了。’’，李燕说完，我大呼了口气，好在她也知道为了她自己的面子撒了一次慌。

这种看起来很随便的安排，让在场的观众很是不满，本应该最激烈的对决，居然变成了不温不火的闯阵。但当白兰花宣布毒阵是由黑煞门两个长老操刀，亲手布置的“黑煞降魔阵”的时候，现场变得安静了。

两人之前不知道已经比试过多少次，因此算是知根知底。乔晟腾空高高跃起，一把银锤带着白色光华呼啸而来，另一把则跟在后面狠狠敲击在前锤上，前锤携带着不可抵挡的力量砸向聂天雷。

眼看着，一轮火红的太阳渐渐西下，然后，悄无声息地坠入连绵的山峰后面，一眨眼，便消失不见了。

燕郡城上空，元尾轻轻摇动一对墨色麟翼，麟翼上蔓延的黑色冰气凝聚成一片墨云隐藏了他和云异的身影。

“我杀，我杀！”毒霸天无论怎样催动法决，他发现都是在做无用功，没有任何响动出来，那团黑雾同样如此，也没有任何反应。

“怎么，黑菱格呢？又有大宗棺材去拖运了？”岱普诺继续像不知情者唠家常一样问着，他已经知道了黑白菱格棺材铺现今落入魔族的严密监视下，接下来想知道的是焕-汀的母亲被关在了哪儿。

贺常齐其实也是焦虑担忧的很，哪里还有过年的心思，整日里早出晚归都是去打探北境边军的情况，甚至是托关系问到了魏王妃那里。

Since ancient times, cultivating immortals has been orthodox. If you become an immortal, you can know the world, gain eternal life, and create a new world; if you become a demon, everyone will beat you up, because once you become a demon, you will often master the rules, avoid life and death, and destroy the world.And since ancient times, it is said that only one person has successfully become a demon, and the others were burned to ashes by his own reversal of spiritual power.

After taking a few more pills, ice mist shot out from his body, and he wanted to use ice spells to resist this fire prison!The ice mist and flames collide, creating huge energy fluctuations!A huge energy whirlwind blew up, and the pressure inside the Fire Prison slowed down a lot for a while.

''It's okay, Teacher Li. It's just that the big calendar fell off. You don't have to worry about it. I can just do it myself.’’ After Li Yan finished speaking, I let out a big breath. Fortunately, she also knew that she was embarrassed for the sake of her own face.

This seemingly casual arrangement made the audience very dissatisfied. What should have been the most intense duel turned into a tepid battle.But when Bai Lanhua announced that the poisonous array was the "Heisha Demon Subduing Array" personally arranged by two elders of the Heisha Sect, the scene became quiet.

The two of them had competed countless times before, so they knew the basics.Qiao Sheng jumped high into the air, and a silver hammer roared towards him with white brilliance. The other one followed behind and struck hard on the front hammer. The front hammer hit Nie Tianlei with irresistible force.

As we watched, the flaming red sun gradually set in the west, then quietly fell behind the continuous mountain peaks, and disappeared in the blink of an eye.

In the sky above Yanjun City, Yuan Wei gently shook a pair of ink-colored Lin wings. The black ice air spreading on the Lin wings condensed into an ink cloud, hiding his and Yun Yi's figures.

"I'll kill, I'll kill!" No matter how Du Batian activated his spells, he found that they were all in vain and there was no sound. The same was true for the black mist, which had no reaction.

"What, where is the black diamond? Are there a large number of coffins to be hauled again?" Daipu Nuo continued to ask like an uninformed person chatting about everyday things. He already knew that the black and white diamond coffin shop was now under the strict surveillance of the demon clan. The next thing he wanted to know was where Huan-Ting's mother was being held.

He Changqi was actually very anxious and worried. He was not thinking about celebrating the New Year. He went out early and came back late all day long to inquire about the situation of the border troops in the north. He even asked Princess Wei through some connections.
